source.description: Brice supplied Adrian's repeat tape values and four current physique photos on October 5, 2026.
source.publication: Numeric values may be used in the public study. The chat-uploaded photo binaries are not republished by this record.

conditions.same_time_as_163_2_lb_weight: intended by coach, not explicitly confirmed in the supplied message

thigh_relaxed_in.note: Prior side was not recorded, and current side ordering was not supplied. Do not claim a side-specific change.

calf_in.note: Side and landmark were not confirmed; treat the nominal difference as possible measurement noise until repeated.

comparison_to_20260924.interpretation: Waist is unchanged while chest and relaxed arm are nominally higher. The lower-body values are essentially flat/uncertain at this checkpoint. One repeat tape set without confirmed landmarks or capture conditions is not proof of hypertrophy.

photos.capture_note: The four images appear to be from the same session/location and show a relaxed physique set. No claim is made that camera distance, focal length, lighting, pump status, meal timing or relation to training matches earlier reference images.
photos.study_role: current reference set; useful qualitative context, not a standardized before/after comparison

current_read: The direction is encouraging but still early: waist is stable at 31 in, chest is 36 in (+0.25 nominally) and relaxed arm is 11.5 in (+0.5 nominally) versus September 24. Thighs are 20/19.75 in and calf 15.5 in. Because the first checkpoint did not document side/landmarks and the new capture conditions are incomplete, the study records the values without converting them into a hypertrophy claim.
next_collection: Repeat the same tape locations, record side for thigh/calf, and capture time of day, relation to training, pump status and comparable morning body mass. Continue preserving the high-level marathon constraint.
scope: Body-evidence update only. No automatic change to run or strength prescription.
